meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Singapore merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Statistics Act 1973
reports.publisher: Parliament of Singapore / Singapore Statutes Online
reports.description: Foundational legislation establishing the Singapore Department of Statistics and research and statistics units, empowering the Chief Statistician as national statistical coordinator, and providing the legal basis for data collection, processing, confidentiality and dissemination of official statistics.

reports.title: Gross Domestic Product (Advance and Quarterly Estimates)
reports.description: Advance GDP estimates released within ~2 weeks of quarter-end and full quarterly GDP (production, expenditure and income approaches) released later in the quarter; annual comprehensive revision embedded in the Economic Survey process.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Monthly CPI measuring changes in the price level of a fixed basket of goods and services consumed by resident households; includes breakdowns by household income group and detailed item indices.

reports.title: Population Trends
reports.description: Annual report presenting the latest statistics and analysis on Singapore’s population size and structure, households and housing, family formation and dissolution, fertility and mortality.

reports.title: Yearbook of Statistics Singapore
reports.description: Flagship annual compilation providing a comprehensive statistical record of key socio-demographic and economic characteristics of Singapore across ~25–27 chapters and 270+ tables.

reports.title: Economic Survey of Singapore
reports.description: Quarterly and annual survey of Singapore’s economic performance, sectoral developments, labour market, costs and prices, external trade, balance of payments and outlook; incorporates DOS national-accounts data with policy commentary.

reports.title: Official Foreign Reserves
reports.description: Monthly data on Singapore’s official foreign reserves (foreign currency assets, gold, SDRs and IMF reserve position), published both in Singapore-dollar and US-dollar terms; also includes the IMF Data Template on International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity.

reports.title: Monthly Statistical Bulletin
reports.description: Monthly compilation of key monetary, banking, financial-market and selected economic indicators for Singapore, including money and banking aggregates, interest rates, exchange rates and housing/bridging loans.

reports.title: Labour Market Report
reports.publisher: Manpower Research and Statistics Department, Ministry of Manpower
reports.description: Quarterly comprehensive assessment of Singapore’s labour market covering employment change (resident and non-resident), unemployment, retrenchments, re-entry into employment, job vacancies, labour turnover and hours worked. Accompanied by an advance-release version roughly six weeks earlier.

reports.title: Monthly Unemployment Situation / End Monthly Unemployment
reports.publisher: Manpower Research and Statistics Department, Ministry of Manpower
reports.description: Timely monthly release of overall, resident and citizen unemployment rates and numbers, providing the earliest signal of labour-market conditions between the fuller quarterly Labour Market Reports.

reports.title: Balance of Payments
reports.description: Quarterly statement summarising economic transactions between Singapore residents and non-residents (current account, capital and financial account, reserve assets). Compiled under the Statistics Act and released with the Economic Survey cycle.

reports.title: Merchandise Trade Statistics
reports.publisher: Enterprise Singapore (compiled from Singapore Customs data; disseminated via DOS)
reports.description: Monthly statistics on total merchandise trade, domestic exports, non-oil domestic exports (NODX), re-exports and imports, broken down by commodity and market. Primary source for external-trade chapters of the Economic Survey.

reports.title: Key Household Income Trends
reports.description: Annual paper presenting median and average household market income (employment plus non-employment sources), income growth by decile, Gini coefficients before and after government transfers, and related distributional indicators for resident households.

reports.title: Household Expenditure Survey
reports.description: Quinquennial survey-based report on household consumption expenditure patterns, online spending, ownership of consumer durables, and related socio-economic characteristics of resident households. Latest full report covers 2023.

reports.title: International Investment Position
reports.description: Quarterly statement of the value and composition of Singapore’s cross-border financial assets and liabilities (direct investment, portfolio investment, financial derivatives, other investment, reserve assets) at a point in time. Net IIP shows Singapore as a consistent net creditor.

reports.title: Labour Force in Singapore
reports.publisher: Manpower Research and Statistics Department, Ministry of Manpower
reports.description: Annual comprehensive report on resident labour-force outcomes drawn from the Comprehensive Labour Force Survey. Covers labour-force participation, employment rates, income growth, job mobility, underemployment and structural trends (ageing, female participation). Accompanied by an advance release.

reports.title: Index of Industrial Production
reports.publisher: Economic Development Board (Research & Statistics Unit); disseminated via Singapore Department of Statistics
reports.description: Monthly index measuring real output of the manufacturing sector, broken down by major clusters (electronics, chemicals, biomedical, precision engineering, transport engineering, general manufacturing). Rebased periodically (most recently to 2025=100).

reports.title: Unit Business Cost / Unit Labour Cost Indices
reports.description: Quarterly indices tracking unit business costs and unit labour costs for the overall economy and manufacturing sector; used as competitiveness and cost-pressure indicators in the Economic Survey of Singapore.

reports.title: Singapore in Figures
reports.description: Annual (and interactive electronic) reference publication presenting key top-line economic, demographic, social and environmental indicators of Singapore in a concise, user-friendly format. Complements the more detailed Yearbook of Statistics.

reports.title: External Debt Statistics
reports.description: Quarterly gross external debt liabilities of Singapore residents to non-residents, broken down by institutional sector, original maturity (short-term / long-term) and instrument type, including inter-company lending under direct investment. Compiled on BPM6 basis.

reports.title: Foreign Direct Investment in Singapore
reports.description: Annual statistics on the stock and flows of foreign direct investment in Singapore by source economy, industry and component (equity capital, retained earnings, net inter-company lending). Principal series and detailed breakdowns published by DOS.

reports.title: Singapore’s Direct Investment Abroad
reports.description: Annual statistics on the stock and flows of Singapore’s direct investment abroad by destination economy, industry and component. Complements the FDI-in-Singapore series and feeds the international investment position.

reports.title: Household Sector Balance Sheet
reports.description: Quarterly statement of the household sector’s financial and non-financial assets (currency & deposits, shares & securities, life insurance, CPF, residential property) and liabilities (mortgages, personal loans), yielding household net worth.

reports.title: Singapore Manufactured Products & Domestic Supply Price Indices
reports.description: Monthly price indices measuring changes in prices of goods manufactured in Singapore (SMPPI) and of goods supplied to the domestic economy (DSPI — local manufactures plus retained imports). Also covers related import and export price indices.

reports.title: Retail Sales Index and Food & Beverage Services Index
reports.description: Monthly indices measuring the sales performance of the Retail Trade and Food & Beverage services industries (value and volume terms, seasonally adjusted and unadjusted). Rebased periodically (most recently to 2025=100).

reports.title: International Visitor Arrivals and Tourism Receipts
reports.publisher: Singapore Tourism Board (data disseminated via DOS / SingStat)
reports.description: Monthly international visitor arrivals by place of residence (derived from SG Arrival Cards / immigration records) and quarterly/annual tourism receipts by major component. Core tourism-sector performance indicators.

reports.title: Job Vacancies Report
reports.publisher: Manpower Research and Statistics Department, Ministry of Manpower
reports.description: Annual detailed analysis of the job-vacancy situation, covering newly created versus replacement vacancies, occupational and industry demand, skills requirements, and duration of unfilled vacancies. Complements the quarterly job-vacancy figures in the Labour Market Report.

reports.title: Supply, Use and Input-Output Tables
reports.description: Annual (and benchmark) Supply and Use Tables recording production, intermediate consumption and final demand by product and industry, together with derived Input-Output Tables used for impact analysis, multipliers and industry inter-dependence studies. Central framework for reconciling the three approaches to GDP.

reports.title: Wholesale Trade Index and Business Receipts Index
reports.description: Quarterly indices measuring short-term performance of the wholesale trade industry (Domestic and Foreign WTI) and of selected services industries (Business Receipts Index, excluding wholesale, retail, accommodation and food services). Value and volume measures.

reports.title: Services Producer Price Indices
reports.description: Quarterly price indices measuring changes in the average prices of services produced by establishments in selected priority industries (sea freight transport, warehousing & storage, cargo handling, freight forwarding, telecommunications, computer consultancy & information services, accounting, postal & courier, etc.).

reports.title: Complete Life Tables for Singapore Resident Population
reports.description: Annual publication presenting complete life tables and key trends in life expectancy at birth and at selected ages for the Singapore resident population, by sex.

reports.title: Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2025
reports.description: National standard for classifying economic activities of economic units. Adopted framework of ISIC Rev. 5 with Singapore-specific adaptations. Used across censuses, surveys and administrative databases. One-off foundational classification instrument (updated periodically).

reports.title: Singapore Standard Occupational Classification 2024
reports.description: National standard for classifying occupations. Adopts the basic framework of ISCO-08 with national adaptations. Used in censuses, household surveys and administrative databases. One-off foundational classification instrument (updated periodically).

reports.title: Report on Wage Practices
reports.publisher: Manpower Research and Statistics Department, Ministry of Manpower
reports.description: Annual report examining employees’ wage changes and private-sector establishments’ wage practices, including nominal and real wage growth, incidence of wage increases, and adoption of Flexible Wage System components.

reports.title: Business Expectations of the Services and Manufacturing Sectors
reports.publisher: Singapore Department of Statistics (Services) / Economic Development Board (Manufacturing)
reports.description: Quarterly survey-based indicators of firms’ general business outlook for the next six months and their operating revenue/output and employment forecasts for the next quarter. Net weighted balances are the primary published metric.

reports.title: Births and Fertility Statistics
reports.publisher: Singapore Department of Statistics (rates) / Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (registration)
reports.description: Annual (and monthly/quarterly detail) statistics on live-births, crude birth rates, total fertility rate, age-specific fertility rates and related fertility indicators for the resident and citizen populations.

reports.title: Enterprise Landscape and Corporate Sector Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistics on the number, ownership (local/foreign), size (SME/non-SME) and revenue-band structure of enterprises, together with balance-sheet aggregates for the corporate sector (total assets, equity, etc.).

dependencies.basis: The quarterly and annual Economic Survey of Singapore reports contain policy statements and data; DOS’s data are acknowledged and separated from the Ministry’s policy statements. GDP estimates (advance and preliminary) are supplied by DOS for incorporation into the Survey.

The Yearbook of Statistics Singapore draws its national-accounts series (including GDP by industry and expenditure) from the official estimates compiled and published by the Singapore Department of Statistics.
Demographic statistics and population-structure series appearing in the Yearbook are taken from the annual Population Trends report and related vital-registration compilations of DOS.

The Economic Survey of Singapore incorporates Balance of Payments data compiled by DOS; the BOP figures are supplied under embargo to MTI for inclusion in the quarterly and annual Survey chapters on external accounts.

Merchandise trade statistics (total trade, NODX, re-exports, imports by commodity and market) compiled by Enterprise Singapore and disseminated via DOS form the primary source material for the external-trade chapter of the Economic Survey of Singapore.

The quarterly Labour Market Report incorporates and expands upon the monthly unemployment rates and numbers previously released in the End Monthly Unemployment Situation series; the monthly figures provide the high-frequency backbone for the quarterly analysis.
Household-income series and distributional indicators appearing in the Yearbook of Statistics are drawn from the annual Key Household Income Trends paper and related DOS compilations.

The International Investment Position is compiled on a consistent conceptual framework with the Balance of Payments (BPM6), showing the stock positions that correspond to the flow transactions recorded in the BOP financial account and reserve assets.
The Economic Survey of Singapore regularly incorporates the Index of Industrial Production (and its cluster breakdowns) as the primary monthly indicator of manufacturing-sector performance.

The annual Labour Force in Singapore report draws on the same underlying Labour Force Survey infrastructure as the quarterly Labour Market Reports, but expands coverage to structural indicators (LFPR, employment rates by demographic group, income growth, job mobility) not fully treated in the quarterly cycle.
Singapore in Figures presents condensed top-line indicators drawn from the fuller statistical series published in the Yearbook of Statistics and other DOS releases.

External debt statistics form a key component of the liabilities side of the International Investment Position and are compiled on a consistent BPM6 conceptual framework with the IIP and Balance of Payments.

The annual FDI stock and flow series provide the detailed direct-investment component that is aggregated into the quarterly International Investment Position (assets and liabilities under direct investment).

Singapore’s Direct Investment Abroad statistics supply the outward direct-investment stock and flow detail that feeds the assets side of the International Investment Position under the direct-investment functional category.

The Household Sector Balance Sheet provides the stock counterpart (net worth, asset and liability composition) to the flow and distributional income measures published in Key Household Income Trends; both are DOS household-sector products used together in analyses of household financial position.

The Supply and Use Tables provide the detailed product-by-industry framework used to reconcile and balance the production, expenditure and income approaches to GDP; they form the core of the annual national-accounts balancing process.

The annual Job Vacancies Report expands on the quarterly job-vacancy stock and rate figures already published in the Labour Market Report, adding detailed occupational, industry and skills analysis from the dedicated Job Vacancy Survey.
The Economic Survey of Singapore regularly incorporates the Retail Sales Index and Food & Beverage Services Index as key monthly indicators of domestic demand and services-sector performance.
Tourism arrivals and receipts figures compiled by the Singapore Tourism Board appear in the sectoral and external-demand chapters of the Economic Survey of Singapore.
Services Producer Price Indices are used as price deflators in the compilation of real (volume) measures of services output within the national accounts / GDP estimates.
The Complete Life Tables draw on the same vital-registration and population data that underpin the mortality and life-expectancy sections of the annual Population Trends report.
The Index of Industrial Production and other industry statistics are classified and aggregated according to the Singapore Standard Industrial Classification.
Occupational breakdowns in the Labour Force in Singapore report and related labour-market statistics are coded to the Singapore Standard Occupational Classification.

The Report on Wage Practices provides the detailed annual wage-change and wage-practice analysis that complements the employment, vacancy and turnover indicators published in the quarterly Labour Market Report.
Business-expectations net balances for manufacturing and services regularly appear in the Economic Survey of Singapore as forward-looking indicators of sectoral activity.
Birth counts, crude birth rates and total fertility rates form a core chapter of the annual Population Trends publication.
Enterprise counts and sectoral breakdowns are classified according to the Singapore Standard Industrial Classification.

_dropped.why: Per data-spec v2 rule 2c, no institutional-identity nodes are created for the Department of Statistics or Research and Statistics Units. The Act itself is retained as the one-off foundational instrument; all subsequent reports simply list the relevant publisher string.

_dropped.edge: possible MOM Labour Market reports -> sg-gdp / national accounts
_dropped.why: Manpower Research and Statistics Department (MOM) produces detailed quarterly Labour Market reports, unemployment time series and the Yearbook of Manpower Statistics. These are high-priority for batch 2; dependency evidence (whether they feed or are fed by national-accounts employment/compensation series) requires targeted methodology checks and is therefore deferred rather than guessed.

DOS publishes monthly Merchandise Trade statistics that appear in the Economic Survey’s external-trade chapter. Exact citation language and frequency alignment will be confirmed in a later trade-focused batch; no edge minted yet.

Explicitly avoided per v2 rule 2b. No ‘Singapore statistical system framing’, ‘batch-meta’ or other non-publication, non-instrument synthesis nodes were created. When material is exhausted the batch simply stops.

While national-accounts employment and compensation series are conceptually related to MOM labour-market statistics, no explicit methodology document or press-release language was located in this pass stating that the Labour Market Report feeds the GDP estimates (or vice versa). Deferred for a later methodology deep-dive rather than inventing a basis.

HES results are the classic source for CPI basket weights in most statistical systems. Singapore documentation almost certainly links them, but the precise statement and current weight-update cycle were not pulled in this batch; flagged for confirmation rather than assumed.

_dropped.edge: Job Vacancies annual report / Report on Wage Practices
_dropped.why: MOM also publishes an annual Job Vacancies report and a Report on Wage Practices. These are real recurring products but secondary to the core Labour Market Report and Monthly Unemployment series; left for a later labour-deepening batch.
DOS publishes quarterly International Investment Position statistics. Closely related to BOP but distinct enough to warrant its own node in a subsequent external-accounts batch.

DOS publishes quarterly External Debt statistics that form part of the broader international accounts suite. Closely related to IIP but distinct enough to warrant its own node in a later external-accounts deepening batch.

_dropped.edge: Direct Investment Abroad / Foreign Direct Investment in Singapore (annual)
_dropped.why: DOS publishes annual (and advance) statistics on Singapore’s Direct Investment Abroad and Foreign Direct Investment in Singapore. These are high-value products but secondary to the quarterly IIP stock measures for this batch.

_dropped.edge: Job Vacancies Report / Report on Wage Practices
_dropped.why: Still deferred from batch 2; useful MOM products but lower priority than the core Labour Market Report and Labour Force in Singapore annual.

_dropped.edge: Producer Price Indices / Import-Export Price Indices
_dropped.why: DOS maintains several producer and trade price indices that feed into national-accounts deflators and cost analysis. Real products, but left for a prices-focused batch.

_dropped.edge: Import Price Index / Export Price Index as separate nodes
_dropped.why: Import and Export Price Indices are published alongside the Singapore Manufactured Products and Domestic Supply Price Indices in the same monthly release cycle and methodology family. They are retained as part of the broader producer/trade-price suite under the single node rather than split into additional nodes for this batch.

Economic Development Board publishes annual investment commitment figures (Fixed Asset Investment and Total Business Expenditure). These are useful forward-looking indicators but are distinct from the stock/flow FDI statistics compiled by DOS; left for a later investment-promotion or EDB-focused pass.

DOS also compiles a set of quarterly Services Producer Price Indices (e.g., telecommunications, accounting, cargo handling). Real products, but secondary to the goods-focused SMPPI/DSPI for this batch.
Still carried forward from earlier batches; lower priority relative to the core labour and external-accounts products already captured.

_dropped.edge: Report on Wage Practices / Annual Wage Change Survey
_dropped.why: MOM also publishes an annual Report on Wage Practices. Real product, but secondary to the Job Vacancies Report and the core Labour Market / Labour Force series already captured; left for a later labour-deepening pass if needed.

DOS compiles a family of quarterly Services Producer Price Indices. Useful, but the goods-focused SMPPI/DSPI (batch 4) and the activity indices (this batch) already cover the main price and volume signals for services; full SPPI suite deferred.

_dropped.edge: Wholesale Trade Index / Business Receipts Index
_dropped.why: DOS also publishes quarterly Wholesale Trade and Business Receipts indices. Related services activity measures; lower priority than the monthly Retail/F&B indices for this batch.
Hotel performance statistics are published by STB alongside visitor arrivals. They are treated as supporting detail within the broader tourism node rather than a separate report for this batch.
Still carried forward; lower priority than the core labour and classification products already included.

_dropped.edge: Singapore Services Sector annual structural report
_dropped.why: DOS publishes an annual structural overview of the services sector. Useful, but the quarterly activity and price indices already provide the high-frequency signals.
ICA/STB data on outbound resident departures exist but are secondary to the inbound visitor-arrivals series already captured in batch 5.

ACRA publishes monthly live counts, formations and cessations. These are useful administrative series but are treated as supporting detail to the DOS Enterprise Landscape statistics rather than a separate node for this batch.

_dropped.edge: Singapore Services Sector annual structural report
_dropped.why: Still available; lower priority now that the high-frequency activity and price indices plus the enterprise landscape are covered.
Real DOS/ICA product that sits alongside births and life tables; can be added in a final demographic mop-up if needed.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
_gaps.not_a_publication_note: These 0 nodes were checked against the web and are not published documents — synthesised 'meta'/'framing' nodes that only bind other nodes together, geographic areas, industries, projects, or institutions. The data spec (2b/2c) bans all of these. They are flagged in place with _flagged_not_a_publication rather than deleted, so you can strip them in one pass once you agree. 0 dependency edges in this file touch one.
